items.prompt: What would you ask before using ordinary DSU for a live relationship network?
items.modelAnswer: Check whether updates only add links, whether deletions/rollback are needed, identity scope, representative-label requirements, concurrency and original-history/path needs. State amortized versus per-operation expectations.
